name: Majutsushi no Akumu
source:
I dreamed of a magician.

"I'm a poor, pitiful sorcerer.
The evil magician has trapped me.
Will you defeat the evil magician to save me?"

When I awoke from the dream, I was in a hospital.
Even when asked my name, I couldn’t remember it.
I had lost my memory—

“If you don’t keep your promise to the magician, you’ll die.”
But who really is the “evil magician” he spoke of…?

A dark fantasy, survival, and neo-romance game set on a secluded island.
translation:
我梦见了一个魔术师。

“我是一个可怜的、可怜的巫师。
邪恶的魔法师把我困住了。
你会打败邪恶的魔法师来拯救我吗？”

当我从梦中醒来时，我已经在医院了。
即使问起我的名字，我也想不起来。
我失去了记忆——

“如果你不遵守对魔法师的承诺，你就会死。”
但他口中的“邪恶魔法师”究竟是谁……？

一款以一座僻静岛屿为背景的黑暗奇幻、生存和新浪漫游戏。
